paper_claims.claim: VoLoAgent achieves 41.80% overall success on RoboVoLo versus 12.57% for pure pi0.5.
VoLoAgent recovers 54% of execution errors in world failure analysis (38 out of 70 failures recovered).
On real Franka FR3 robot, VoLoAgent achieves 42.9% success versus 14.3% for pi0.5 across 14 tasks x 3 trials.
RoboVoLo introduces 126 tasks across 15 categories and 501 new realistic 3D assets in RoboLab / Isaac Lab.
The system interleaves 15Hz continuous VLA / primitive execution with 0.2Hz VLM completion monitoring.
